act_range.description: Observed 0x18-byte ACT kernel-range record. Its relocation selects code in KernelText; the +0x0c extent is an execution-tested inference for this supported carrier family.

act_invocation.description: Observed 0x40-byte ACT invocation record. Its +0 word selects a range in the supported compiler family; other decoded words remain carrier-specific where noted.

code_image.description: Exact KernelText byte slice selected by a range relocation addend and the observed range extent.

rela.description: Standard ELF64 Rela entry connecting a field in the target section to a symbol plus an addend.

fields.description: SHAVE virtual address recorded for this range's executable image.
Relocation-backed reference field targeting the KernelText section.
Observed executable extent at record +0x0c; its bounding role is an execution-tested inference.
Zero-based ACT range selector, confirmed for the supported compiler family.
Relocation-backed reference to this invocation's KernelParams base.
Relocation-backed data-reference field; its detailed ABI remains carrier-specific.
Raw record word at +0x30 exposed for diagnosis; no general semantic contract is claimed.
Raw +0x34 value that strongly correlates with tile selection; exact relocation semantics remain open.
Raw record word at +0x38 exposed for diagnosis; no general semantic contract is claimed.
Offset within the relocation section's target section.
Symbol-table index encoded in the Rela information word.
Relocation type encoded in the Rela information word.
Signed constant addend applied by the relocation.

section_descriptions..text.KernelText: Executable SHAVE code storage. ACT range relocations select byte slices within this section.
section_descriptions..text.KernelData: Kernel-associated data storage; this viewer does not infer an ABI for its contents.
section_descriptions..text.KernelParams: ACT kernel parameter records referenced by invocation relocations; detailed layouts remain carrier-specific.
section_descriptions..text.ActKernelRanges: Observed 0x18-byte ACT range records that reference executable slices in KernelText.
section_descriptions..text.ActKernelInvocations: Observed 0x40-byte ACT invocation records that connect scheduled work to ranges and parameters.
